column1: # serve-smoke rows for safetensors packs (tools/serve-smoke.sh with a checkpoint directory).
# A directory's pack is the one its config contract selects (`memra model inspect`, the artifact
# lock's family=); its row says what the battery boots with and which arms it runs. A GGUF file
# reads no row and runs every arm, as before.
#   server_env space-separated NAME=value pairs the server boots with ("-" for none)
#   arms       comma-separated arms: plain (checks 1-7), cache-meter, spec, gemma4, q35-cold, moe-spec
